verdicts.note: Chief criminal deputy handling most felony cases and the outgoing prosecutor's recruited successor [S1][S3], with more than ten years as a prosecutor [S1]. A continuity candidate, but this is her first campaign [S1], so -1 not -2.

Tried to read the hedges ('fairly', charges that 'accurately reflect the conduct', 'understanding when bail is necessary') as a balanced position. They do not reach the prevention pole: the platform is 'enforcing the law ... protecting victims, holding offenders accountable, and prioritizing public safety' [S1], and the bail line argues for bail when needed for safety [S2]. No diversion or treatment language. -1 medium stands.

Thirty years of local practice as city prosecutor, municipal and pro tem judge, superior court commissioner and hearing examiner [S1][S2], and his statement rests on that experience [S1]. He is outside the current prosecutor's office, but nothing in the dossier frames him as a new voice. -1 medium stands.
